description: Use this when a homeowner wants guidance for their five-digit US ZIP or nearby town pages before getting bids. Do not use this to decide whether InstaBids serves a particular US area or restrict where a job can be posted. Homeowners anywhere in the US can post a job; once you send it, InstaBids finds contractors to bid on it. Returns ZIP guidance and nearby town pages, including whether the input is a US ZIP; this is not an availability gate.

zip.description: five-digit US ZIP code of the home where the work is

name: check_service_area
title: Get US ZIP and town guidance
